## Change and reason

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue or methodology proposal.

## Evidence

List checks actually run and their results. For numerical changes, include synthetic
before/after results, units, coverage and explained differences. Identify source pins,
licenses and unresolved comparisons when relevant.

## Compatibility

State whether package API, schema, method or parameter identities change. Explain how
historical results remain replayable, or write "not applicable" for an unrelated change.

- [ ] Shared inputs are synthetic or explicitly redistributable and contain no private data.
- [ ] Relevant documentation and tests reflect the final change.
